title: How I Made Every Interview Feel Rigged in My Favor
description:
The most crucial and under-appreciated part of the application process. Interviewing. How can we not just stand out but become Irresistible.

As of 6:32PM EST on Friday October 10th 2025, I am a lighting expert in Photoshop. Please clap. 

You could have just added a vignette? Maybe? But I tripped and fell down a deep rabbit hole. Hope the thumbnail background looks depthful. 

Contents:

05:36 - Our Questions

26:04 - I ask these everytim

I was going to add the prompts but you can just screenshot and pop it into uncle chat. 

P.S. I'm toying with an idea. A recruiting agency but working for people, not corporations. 
-A team of appliers, trained by me, send out an absurd number of hyper-tailored applications(cover letter the whole shabam). 
-Company communications, scheduling all handled via a custom email. 
-Interviews delivered straight to your calendar with prep documents for all the details/questions you need for the call. 

Am I on to something?
